items.title: Privacy completeness
items.how: All17locales disclose processing purposes, categories, ordinary and sensitive bases, retention, security/destruction, rights/CPO, recipients, optional SDK processing and refusal. Known app behavior and source attribution preserved.
items.remaining: Static candidate wording only; no legal, translation, operational or publication certification.

items.title: Distinct health consent
items.how: Separate optional health-sync consent names medication/schedule/dose, measurements, meals/protein, symptoms/notes; purpose, period and refusal effects. Terms, account consent, analytics and OS permissions do not substitute. Existing-record import remains a distinct choice.
items.remaining: Native/server consent and withdrawal flows remain false-gated; this lane does not verify collection timing.

items.title: Processor roles
items.how: Cloudflare and AWS hosting/security processing separated from optional Firebase/AdMob and Apple/Google sign-in; no blanket contract-necessity classification or encryption exemption.
items.remaining: Actual recipient roles/entities, contracts, SDK inventory and access need owner/provider confirmation.

items.title: PIPA Art28-8 table
items.how: Six services each have8columns: basis, data, country, time/method, recipient/contact, purpose, retention, refusal. Accessible table renders in17locales; verified known facts entered and required unknown facts explicitly unverified.
items.remaining: Cloudflare/AWS/Google/Apple exact legal entities, contacts, actual countries and finite periods are not available in inputs; table cannot be called a completed verified Art28-8 inventory.

items.title: Transfer distinction
items.how: Mandatory sync/announcement route, optional analytics/ad routes, overseas-transfer basis and refusal consequences are distinguished; necessary consent must precede transfer.
items.remaining: Actual transfer basis, pre-consent routing, announcement refusal, ad consent and international safeguards remain unresolved release gates.

items.title: Automatic retention
items.how: Deletion anchored to Store-confirmed last Plus end+30days, with entitlement recheck and only a Store-verification outage deferral of at most7additional days. Fixed anchor preserved across17locales.
items.remaining: Static candidate wording only; no legal, translation, operational or publication certification.

items.title: Immediate user deletion
items.how: User-requested deletion or consent withdrawal bypasses subscription-expiry waiting and outage deferral. Sync-server-copy deletion, full account deletion and independent Store cancellation distinguished; active subscription does not delay account deletion.
items.remaining: Native/server deletion completion and authorization-token lifecycle require operational proof.

items.title: Hybrid backups
items.how: Daily pre-upload client-encrypted app data in S3Seoul and weekly OS recovery snapshots; removed personal data leaves all backups within7days and deleted data cannot return to use after restore. Operating procedure covers versions/replicas/manual snapshots and independent physical cleanup.
items.remaining: Actual provider settings/cleanup/restore proof absent; lifecycle alone is expressly insufficient. No backup setting or native behavior changed by this lane.

items.title: Statutory/other retention
items.how: Separates limited legally justified transaction/verification records from health-sync retention; requires category, legal basis and finite period before retaining a purchase digest/tombstone.
items.remaining: Verifier host and tombstone basis/expiry remain owner/provider facts; no invented legal period.

items.title: Deletion webpage
items.how: Existing support-email request without reinstall or Plus, minimal identity checks and no passwords/recovery codes/health records/purchase tokens; staged account/delete and all localized integration validate noindex/null date.
items.remaining: Actual live/public request route and erasure workflow not verified or published; deletionRequest.published=false. Publishing is forbidden in this lane.

items.title: Rights/CPO
items.how: All17locales use WonyoungLabs where operator is named and disclose WonyoungChoi as representative/CPO, business registration and owner-supplied business address/contact. Rights, withdrawal, refusal reasons and appeal channels retained. Revision 1 also corrects every Android scope operator paragraph; all 102 canonical operator-bearing fields audited.
items.remaining: Static candidate wording only; no legal, translation, operational or publication certification.

items.title: Analytics/advertising
items.how: Optional analytics and nonpersonalized ads remain distinct. Recorded health content is excluded from ads and analytics content fields; health-revealing SDK/account metadata is separately protected and sharing needs applicable separate health consent. No-IDFA/AD_ID does not imply no SDK collection.
items.remaining: Shipped neutral event/screen/error inventory, provider retention/roles and actual regional consent flow need native/SDK proof.

items.title: Health-platform permissions
items.how: Preserves optional read-only platform permissions and manual-entry alternatives, revocation and no health-data advertising use. AndroidMLKit exception remains platform/selected-food-label specific.
items.remaining: Actual requested HealthKit/HealthConnect selectors and shipped permission behavior are native-owner scope.

items.title: Subscription/trial
items.how: All17Terms keep USD1.99/month13.99/year, KRW3300/month22000/year (superseding owner/spec decision) and JPY300/month1980/year; actual localized Store price prevails. Eligible first-time subscribers receive1calendar-month Store free trial, then full selected-plan automatic renewal; cancellation any time through the Store.
items.remaining: Static candidate wording only; no legal, translation, operational or publication certification.

items.title: Korean conversion/increase
items.how: Affirmative consent within the30days preceding free-to-paid conversion or price increase, with date/old and new price/payment/cancellation conditions. No conversion/increase without required consent.
items.remaining: Store product/offer and actual notices/consent coverage require release-owner proof; no Store query or activation performed.

items.title: Refund Terms/renderer
items.how: Store refund channels preserve overriding statutory rights: Korea7day withdrawal, nonconformity within3months of supply and30days of knowledge/could-know, applicable3business-day refund. Account renderer appends account retention rather than replacing billing/refund paragraphs.
items.remaining: Static candidate wording only; no legal, translation, operational or publication certification.

items.title: Recurring charges
items.how: Annual full charge and recurring period prominent; Store cancellation/renewal facts preserved; conditional Korea50–20day continuous-transaction notices, California15–45day annual and7–30day price-change notices/annual reminders identified.
items.remaining: Applicable contract classification and actual Store/operator regional notice coverage require verification.

items.title: Dark-pattern/public claims
items.how: Terms do not imply consent through silence or remove statutory rights; this lane introduces no clinical efficacy, safety, superiority or prescription-purchase claims. Existing legal copy is preserved and regional subscription notice obligations are drafted.
items.remaining: Actual paywall/cancellation/advertising flows, objective-claim substantiation and other-repository native/store/landing audits remain follow-up; no claim-substantiation procedure or complete marketing audit is implemented or proved here.

items.title: Medical wording
items.how: mg estimated residual amount retained per final owner decision. All17locales strengthen reference-only/not medical advice, not actual blood concentration/effectiveness measurement and not dose/time/treatment adjustment guidance; Terms use matching source wording.
items.remaining: Static candidate wording only; no legal, translation, operational or publication certification.

items.title: Separate US Consumer Health Data policy
items.how: Separate prominent linked us-health route and17locale pages, categories/purposes/sources/recipient classes/affiliates, separate collection and sharing consent, narrow requested-service necessity, no health sale/geofencing, rights and downstream erasure.
items.remaining: Static candidate wording only; no legal, translation, operational or publication certification.

items.title: Regional rights
items.how: Korea10day and EU/UK1month rights plus JapanAPPI and BrazilLGPD/ANPD disclosure. US: Washington45+45/appeal45, Nevada45+45/deletion30/appeal45, Connecticut45+45/appeal60/withdrawal15. Stricter immediate operational deletion and7day backup promise preserved.
items.remaining: Rights/appeal/downstream-recipient response workflows and machine-readable portability need operational proof.

items.title: International disclosures
items.how: 1.0.6 EU/EEA, UK and Switzerland sales excluded; no EU/UK representative designated or appointment placeholder. Applicable existing-user Art.6/9 bases, one-month rights, safeguards, transfer mechanisms and breach clocks preserved; actual Store exclusions remain false-gated.
items.remaining: Actual Store availability readback and recipient-specific safeguards/contracts/DPIA/processing records remain unverified. Appointment is not a prerequisite for this decided 1.0.6 scope; future reopening needs an applicability review.

items.title: Children
items.how: Existing adult-only service copy is preserved. No regional child applicability assessment, parental-consent workflow or age-control implementation was added by this lane.
items.remaining: Regional child-directed/actual-knowledge applicability, age gating and any required parental-consent controls are NOT_IMPLEMENTED/native-operational follow-up. The listed processing test is not child-control proof; no universal COPPA/GDPR-child certification.

items.title: Breach response
items.how: All17privacy drafts and internal procedure include unauthorizedSDK disclosure and health-revealing metadata. PIPA72h includes independent sensitive-data/unlawful-access triggers; FTC without unreasonable delay/max60calendar days,500+ concurrentFTC and state-media trigger,smaller FTC60days afteryearend; GDPR72h authority/high-risk individual notice.
items.remaining: Named incident escalation/drills, notification channels and actual processor incident arrangements remain false-gated; drafted procedure is not executed response proof.

items.title: Platform boundaries
items.how: 17locales/RTL/stablehash/noJS fallback/source attribution/local links maintained; iOS platform-specific copy guarded against Android/GooglePlay branding. Website-source/render parity and localizedUS route checked; AndroidMLKit exception not generalized to iOS/web. Canonical/staged iOS policy/help contain no Android/Google Play; full shared retention survives localized neutral store names, including separate verifier 90/30-day clauses.
items.remaining: Store privacy/health declarations, trader/merchant/Organization-account requirements, app behavior and public URL availability are external/native/store-owner gates, not claimed complete.

items.title: Major: Korean annual price
items.how: 17 offers, renderer/test expectations and regenerated Terms use KRW22,000/year; actual Store prices still prevail.

items.title: Major: Android business operator
items.how: All 17 Android scope paragraphs now name Wonyoung Labs; representative/privacy officer and unrelated age/consent clauses preserved.

items.title: Major: sales exclusions and representatives
items.how: All 34 policy paragraphs, exact metadata, readiness validation and operations align with excluded markets/no appointed reps; existing-user rights/safeguards retained.

items.title: Minor: competing platform/store names in iOS copy
items.how: Neutralized all canonical/staged iOS policy/help platform/store references while preserving all retention/verifier clauses and numbers.
